decisions.reason: Although the accelerator is less central than the firm's machinery business, it was put on the home page and supports the publicly stated innovation and partnership strategy, so management is likely to continue it for now.

The bitumen binder is the least visible and least clearly aligned with the firm's core modular recycling-equipment direction, so despite sunk development effort management is comparatively more likely to stop it and refocus resources.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the established offer, was promoted prominently on the home page, and fits the firm's engineering capabilities, making continued commitment likely.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly consistent with the firm's core decentralized recycling strategy and visible public commitment, so management would be strongly inclined to persist with it.
